articles.summary: TORONTO, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Colliers International Group Inc. (TSX NASDAQ: CIGI) (“Colliers” or the “Company”) today announced that results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, will be issued by press release on November 4, 2026, at approximately 7:00am ET. A conference call to review these results will take place at 11:00am ET on November 4, 2026 and will be hosted by Jay S. Hennick, Global Chairman CEO and Christian Mayer, CFO CEO of Commercial Real Estate. The telephone numbers for this call are: Local 1-585-542-9983 and Toll Free – NA 1-833-461-5787 with conference meeting ID 768704731. The conference call will also be accessible via webcast at corporate.colliers.com/en in the “Events” section. For anyone unable to listen to the scheduled call, the webcast replay will be available on the webcast attendee link. articles.summary: Establishes beachhead in Canadian oil & gas sector and adds significant scale and multidisciplinary expertise in Alberta TORONTO and CALGARY, Alberta, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Colliers International Group Inc. (TSX and NASDAQ: CIGI) announced today that its Canadian engineering platform, Englobe Corporation (“Englobe”), has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Obsidian Engineering Corp. (“Obsidian”), a leading Calgary-based multidisciplinary engineering firm specializing in engineering, procurement and construction management (“EPCM”) services for private-sector clients. The acquisition expands Englobe's capabilities, adds scale across Western Canada, and establishes a significant presence in Canada's critical energy infrastructure market. Founded in 2017, Obsidian’s over 400 professionals have delivered more than 3,500 projects across Canada’s energy and data centre markets.
